cap1.source: New CPU fp32 projection of unchanged cached features; maximum of projected scores

shelf0.source: New CPU fp32 projection of unchanged cached features; maximum of projected scores

aggregation: Exhaustive reference subsets averaged within category; unweighted category mean.
object_metrics: Archived R2 O-AUROC on COMMON50; cap1 and shelf0 use the identical maximum projected-point readout from unchanged cached descriptors.
cap1_derivation: New CPU fp32 Gaussian projection, no training or feature extraction. P-AUROC cross-check within 2e-6 of original B1 for all three scorers.
published_comparison: Published COSSAD 52-category result retains its source protocol; the SESAD cache has 1702 query scans. This is not a paired full-pipeline reproduction.
